scope_summary: One generated twin2mc-* IAM deployment user in the selected AWS account, one attached customer-managed thesis-demo-v2 policy, and one access key; request-scoped bootstrap authority is not retained.
rationale: The Phase 8 PoC already persists AWS deployment CloudConnections as access-key credentials and configures the Terraform AWS provider with those credentials. This explicit binding corrects the executable identity assignment without mutating the frozen thesis-demo-v2 permission inventory.
limitations: The binding is specific to the PoC IAM-user path and does not claim STS AssumeRole support.

The binding adds only the region-discovery and IAM-user self-inspection actions required by the existing Deployer preflight; the customer-managed policy document must remain below the AWS 6,144-character quota and requires supervised IAM Access Analyzer validation before live use.
Static access keys remain a bounded PoC trade-off; workload roles created inside the deployed architecture are separate identities.
